ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 60-70% of the visible surface area, concentrated in the central and inner regions, while low-intensity black pixels define the perimeter edges and the peduncle transition.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white regions dominate the central lobes. Black pigmentation forms thick marginal bands along the trailing edges and outer tips. Significant pixel-level mottling and transition-gradient 'flecking' are visible at the intersection of black and white fields on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of 50-60 degrees, centered between the symmetrical lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, moderate-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge of both lobes, resulting in a jagged linear boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from the distal tips toward the median notch, while the overall lobe shape displays a convex leading-edge curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, irregular white/tan pixel groups (barnacles) are densely packed on the distal tips of both lobes and distributed along the trailing edge serrations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark vertical linear marks are detectable on the white pigmentation of the right lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of calcified barnacle attachments on the distal tips; minor irregular indentations on the trailing edge consistent with physical wear or small amputations.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy water spray and foam occlude the pixels corresponding to the lower peduncle and the ventral insertion point.
